name: inv-1-no-strict-require-constraint
description: No tool constraint may demand JSON-schema strict sampling via strict: "require" — pi-ai's resolveJsonSchemaStrictSampling throws on constraint-ignoring providers when config.strict === "require", failing the child session's request so the extraction fallback never engages (FR-010/NFR-011 zero-new-failure-modes violation). The constraint is a provider request, never an enforcement.
fixHint: Use strict: "prefer" — the constraint rides the harness's constrained-sampling capability as a request; "require" makes pi-ai throw on constraint-ignoring providers (verified against pi 0.83.0). Override this rule by name only if pi-ai's strict semantics change.
